exposure: Postnatal administration of Lactobacillus reuteri (L.reuteri) DSM 17938
cohort: The study included 146 preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks of gestational age from singleton and multiple pregnancies, with an average gestational age of 29.5 weeks and average birth weight of 1319g.
finding: The use of probiotic L. reuteri significantly reduced the incidence of proven late-onset sepsis and mortality in preterm infants less than 32 weeks of gestational age and birth weight less than 1500 g.
birth_weight: Average 1319 g (SD +/- 383 g); subgroup analysis for infants less than 1500 g
gest_age: Less than 32 weeks; average 29.5 weeks (SD +/- 2.2 weeks)
